eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Nevada, CA; at 4:52 PM on AUG 16, 2023 Effective until 7:52 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Nevada County Sheriff's Office issuing an Evacuation Order for zones NCO-E030 for a wildfire located near the Town of Washington. EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY!  Fast moving wildfire is unpredictable and dangerous, collect family members and pets and seek shelter outside of the evacuated zones.  For more information go to bit.ly/NCEvacMap or call 211.
